t: Since in this story there appears a judge who passes his verdict regardless of paragraphs, but according to sound human reason, it follows that the following event could have happened nowhere else than in England; and that it happened in London, more precisely in Kensington; or wait, it was in Brompton or in Bayswater, in short somewhere around there.

t: "Again the knave," Mrs. Myers pondered over the third heap. "My dear child, a great deal of money awaits you; but I still don't know whether you will be making the greater journey, you or someone close to you."

t: "I am going to Southampton to my aunt," said Mrs. Mac Leary.

t: "So here we have it," said Mrs. Myers solemnly over the fifth heap. "Dear Miss Jones, this was the finest card I have ever seen.

t: Within a year you will have a wedding; a very, very rich young man will marry you, a millionaire or a merchant, because he travels a great deal; but before you get there you will have to overcome great obstacles, some older gentleman will stand in your way, but you must persevere.

t: About a year later Judge Kelley ran into Commissioner Mac Leary. "Lovely weather," said the judge amiably. "By the way, how is Mrs. Mac Leary?"
